allow.GET /: public: health check, returns no user data
allow.GET /api/billing/plans: public: static price list for the pricing page
allow.GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/download/{format}: job-token: require_token, the job's share token in ?token=
allow.GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/screenshot_url: job-token-or-owner: optional_auth + require_job_access (share token or owner)
allow.GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/video: job-token: require_token, the job's share token in ?token=
allow.GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/video_url: job-token-or-owner: optional_auth + require_job_access (share token or owner)
allow.GET /api/preload-status: public: model preload health check, returns no user data
allow.GET /docs: framework: FastAPI docs, disabled when ENVIRONMENT=production
allow.GET /docs/oauth2-redirect: framework: FastAPI docs helper, disabled when ENVIRONMENT=production
allow.GET /openapi.json: framework: FastAPI schema, disabled when ENVIRONMENT=production
allow.GET /redoc: framework: FastAPI docs, disabled when ENVIRONMENT=production
allow.POST /api/auth/login: public: sign-in with email and password
allow.POST /api/auth/logout: public: revokes only the caller's own session (test_auth_session_isolation)
allow.POST /api/auth/register: public: account creation, invite-gated in the handler
allow.POST /api/auth/resend-verification: public: resends a verification email, rate-limited by Supabase
allow.POST /api/auth/reset-password: public: password reset with a one-time code (test_auth_session_isolation)
allow.POST /api/auth/verify-email: public: email verification with a one-time code
allow.POST /api/billing/webhook: webhook: Stripe-Signature verified with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET before any write
